metadata.note: Original XY preserved in approximate local metre coordinates. ELEVATION is a relative road level, not metres. Road widths are authored: 6 m for elevated carriageways, 12 m for broad roads including the low Hung Hing / Tonnochy approach, 3.2 m for TD_103438 and 3.0 m for TD_103954, based on source spacing and analytic bus clearance; widths are not surveyed. Tunnel depth 32 m, 5.6 m interior and 7 m elevated decks with cosine ramps over 150 m outside shared level junction aprons are authored. Aprons extend until adjoining centreline branches separate by 7.5 m. Shorelines derive from LandsD iB1000 with recorded gap repairs; the TST apron is bounded by SWA 1101166493 and the joined Site 1503005628 frontage, with source Site footprints retained. The southwest water cut follows georeferenced LandsD KN12/KN13 water fills clipped to legacy ground and edit bounds; a source-free connector through the reviewed offshore gap is clipped to legacy ground and excludes all iB1000 support, with no wall emitted on its edge. iB1000 JPW/FFL decks, building footprints, non-water Site 1503005422 and the charted public promenade beyond the Site are retained. Turn restrictions are not inferred.
